grouping.name: Behavior: Capability Statements
grouping.description: The following artifacts define the specific capabilities that different types of systems are expected to have in order to comply with this implementation guide.  Systems conforming to this implementation guide are expected to declare conformance to one or more of the following capability statements.

grouping.name: Behavior: Message Definitions
grouping.description: These define the types of messages that can be sent and/or received by systems conforming to this implementation guide.

grouping.name: Structures: Abstract Profiles
grouping.description: These are profiles on resources or data types that describe patterns used by other profiles, but cannot be instantiated directly.  I.e. instances can conform to profiles *based* on these abstract profiles but do not declare conformance to the abstract profiles themselves.

grouping.name: Structures: Resource Profiles
grouping.description: These define constraints on FHIR resources for systems conforming to this implementation guide.

grouping.name: Structures: Data Type Profiles
grouping.description: These define constraints on FHIR data types for systems conforming to this implementation guide.

grouping.name: Structures: Extension Definitions
grouping.description: These define constraints on FHIR data types for systems conforming to this implementation guide.

grouping.name: Terminology: Value Sets
grouping.description: These define sets of codes used by systems conforming to this implementation guide.

grouping.name: Terminology: Code Systems
grouping.description: These define new code systems used by systems conforming to this implementation guide.

grouping.name: Example: Example Instances
grouping.description: These are example instances that show what data produced and consumed by systems conforming with this implementation guide might look like.

resource.name: DP_Address
resource.description: Address datatype, only text required, sets lengths for text and key elements.

resource.name: DP_Annotation
resource.description: Text note with attribution.

resource.name: DP_Attachment
resource.description: Attachment datatype, requires either .data or .url, .size and .hash supplied plus other required elements.

resource.name: DP_CodeableConcept
resource.description: A CodeableConcept which requires at least one coding specifying the system and code.

resource.name: DP_CodeableConcept_1
resource.description: A CodeableConcept which requires either one coding specifying the system and code or text.

resource.name: DP_CodeableConcept_2
resource.description: A CodeableConcept which requires at least one and up to two codings specifying the system and code.

resource.name: DP_Coding
resource.description: A Coding datatype which requires the system and code.

resource.name: DP_Dosage
resource.description: Dosage datatype with timing, route and doseAndRate required.

resource.name: DP_HumanName
resource.description: A HumanName datatype, only text required, sets the lengths for text and key elements.

resource.name: DP_Identifier_A
resource.description: Business Identifier for Resources: system and value required.

resource.name: DP_Identifier_B
resource.description: Business Identifier to identify a well-known entity based on the identification standards adopted by NPHIES: type, system and value required.

resource.name: DP_Identifier_C
resource.description: Business Identifier to identify an item such as an EFT or cheque: type and value required.

resource.name: DP_Money
resource.description: Money datatype requiring both currency and the value.

resource.name: DP_Money_SAR
resource.description: Money datatype requiring currency=SAR and the value.

resource.name: DP_Period_1
resource.description: Period datatype which constrains the start and end to complete dates. Both optional.

resource.name: DP_Period_2
resource.description: Period datatype which constrains the start and end to complete dates. Both  required.

resource.name: DP_Period_3
resource.description: Period datatype which constrains the start and end to complete dates. Only start is required.

resource.name: DP_Period_4
resource.description: Period datatype which constrains the start and end to complete dates. Only end is required.

resource.name: DP_Quantity_1
resource.description: Quantity datatype which only requires a value.

resource.name: DP_Quantity_2
resource.description: Quantity data which requires a value, system and code.

resource.name: DP_Range
resource.description: Range datatype requiring both low and high values'

resource.name: DP_Ratio
resource.description: A ratio requiring both numerator and demoninator.

resource.name: DP_Reference_1
resource.description: Reference using the full URL. Example: where the referenced resource will be included within the bundle.

resource.name: DP_Reference_1or2a
resource.description: Reference where either pattern is permitted.

resource.name: DP_Reference_1or2aor4
resource.description: Reference where either pattern is permitted or when providing either name.

resource.name: DP_Reference_1or2b
resource.description: Reference or identifier when providing well known identifiers rather than including a resource when there is a choice of resource types, e.g. Reference(Organization or Practitioner).

resource.name: DP_Reference_1or3a
resource.description: Reference where either pattern is permitted.

resource.name: DP_Reference_1or3b
resource.description: Reference where either a full URL or an Identifier with system, value and optional type.

resource.name: DP_Reference_1or4
resource.description: Reference or identifier or display, used when providing either name example(practitioner name) when the full resource information is unknown or well known identifiers Example: VisionPrescription.prescriber

resource.name: DP_Reference_2a
resource.description: Used when providing well known identifiers rather than including a resource when there is only one valid resource type, e.g. Reference(Organization)

resource.name: DP_Reference_2b
resource.description: used when providing well known identifiers rather than including a resource when there is a choice of resource types, e.g. Reference(Organization or Practitioner)

resource.name: DP_Reference_3a
resource.description: Used when providing the business identifier for a resource when there is only one valid resource type, e.g. Reference(Claim)

resource.name: DP_Reference_3aor4
resource.description: Used when providing the business identifier for a resource when there is only one valid resource type or when providing either name.

resource.name: DP_Reference_3b
resource.description: Used when providing the business identifier for a resource when there is a choice of valid resource types, e.g. Reference(Claim or EligibilityRequest)

resource.name: DP_Reference_4
resource.description: Reference or identifier or display, used when providing either name, such as practitioner name, or when the full resource information is unknown, or well known identifiers. Example: VisionPrescription.prescriber.

resource.name: DP_SimpleQuantity_1
resource.description: SimpleQuantity datatype which only requires a value.

resource.name: DP_SimpleQuantity_2
resource.description: SimpleQuantity data which requires a value, system and code, for example for medication quantity.

resource.name: DP_Timing
resource.description: Timing datatype requiring boundsPeriod, duration, durationUnit and periodUnit.

resource.name: DP_base64Binary
resource.description: String field where contents are a base64 string.

resource.name: DP_canonical
resource.description: Url datatype for specifying canonical urls

resource.name: DP_code
resource.description: A code from a predefined code system.

resource.name: DP_date
resource.description: A date which must be a complete date (YYYY-MM-DD).

resource.name: DP_dateTime
resource.description: DateTime datatype length limited to 29 characters.

resource.name: DP_decimal
resource.description: Decimal datatype length limited to 30 characters.

resource.name: DP_id
resource.description: An id datatype limited to 64 characters.

resource.name: DP_iduuid
resource.description: Id datatype where the content is required to be a GUID (UUID) without the 'urn:uuid:' prefix.

resource.name: DP_instant
resource.description: A time datatype requiring a full timestamp.

resource.name: DP_integer
resource.description: Integer with a maximum length of 12 characters.

resource.name: DP_markdown
resource.description: A string datatype containing text marked-up in markdown with a maximum length of 10MB.

resource.name: DP_oid
resource.description: Oid datatype with a maximum length of 60 characters.

resource.name: DP_positiveInt
resource.description: Positive integer datatype with length limited to 11 characters.

resource.name: DP_string
resource.description: String datatype.

resource.name: DP_time
resource.description: Time datatype requiring complete time (HH:MM:SS).

resource.name: DP_unsignedInt
resource.description: Unsigned integer with a length limit of 11 characters.

resource.name: DP_uri
resource.description: Uri datatype with a length limit of 255 characters.

resource.name: DP_url
resource.description: Url datatype limited to 255 characters.

resource.name: DP_uuid
resource.description: A uuid (GUID) datatype which requires the 'urn:uuid:' prefix.
